description: jskerker/QuantLearning: Data and Code for Quantifying the Value of Learning for Flexible Water Infrastructure Planning is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jennifer Skerker. This release includes Global Climate Model (GCM) data and rainfall-runoff data, as well as code to run the experiments and analysis. Full citation: Skerker, J.B., Zaniolo, M., Willebrand, K., Lickley, M., and Fletcher, S.M., Quantifying the Value of Learning for Flexible Water Infrastructure Planning, Water Resources Research, 2023. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
